Local Comercial en Rentabilidad | 89,92 m² | Contrato 5 Años | +4,24% Rentabilidad | 740.000 €

Inversión segura con ingresos estables desde el primer día.

inv.desc_en:
Commercial Space for Rent | 89.92 m² | 5-Year Contract | +4.24% Profitability | €740,000

Secure investment with stable income from day one.

Commercial space of 89.92 m² for sale with a consolidated tenant and a 5-year lease agreement, generating an annual profitability of 4.24%.

Located on c\/ Hernán Cortés s\/n, an area of high visibility and traffic, this asset is ideal for those looking for security, constant income, and low tenant turnover.

Key features:

Area: 89.92 m²

Current contract: 5 years

Net profitability: 4.24% per year

Solvent tenant with established business

Sale price: €740,000

Important:
To access the detailed documentation and arrange any visits, it will be necessary to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) beforehand.

Contact us for more information.

High profitability. Solid contract. Ideal product for investors.
